player_prompt.intro:
Ngeye Mwana {player_id} mu Chopsticks. Pa kuboko kwenu, sakulula mo:
  + Kukata:  '[attack M O]'  wapi M=boko benu (0 to 1), O=boko bwa mpanzi (0 to 1).
    - Boko bwa mpanzi bukula kwa boko benu; kama >=5, bukala 0.
  + Kusambaza:   '[split L R]'  kusambaza vidole vyenu vyote mu L na R (L+R = vyenu vyote).
Tubisie na kuboko kimoja kati ya mizo.

invalid_move.split_no_change: Split udi ne bua kushintulula mushindu uudi utamba kufila bintu.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Kuboko kibi. Tumie “[attack M O]” to “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} akoya P{opp_id}’s luwa {opp_idx}: inaenda kutoka {opp_val} hadi {new_val}.

outcome.win: Bianza bionso bibidi bia muluishi bidi bifua.
outcome.draw: Tudi bafike ku tshipiminu tshia dikudimuka.
